2608.25241.title: A Few Pages of Markdown: Committed AI Configuration and Lower Quality Cost after Coding-Agent Adoption
2608.25241.paper_summary: Coding agents increase development velocity but also technical debt. Prior work reports only average effects across adopters, hiding wide differences between teams. We introduce RAMP (Repository AI Maturity Profile), a four-level cumulative maturity model grounded in version-controlled artifacts that teams commit to configure AI tools. RAMP runs from behavioral rules and coding standards through named agent definitions to multi-agent orchestration, with observed practice concentrated in the first three levels. Across 441 repositories the levels behave as a cumulative scale, and independent human annotation reproduces RAMP's repository-level labels on 97% of a held-out sample. Adoption is cumulative, forward-only, and set-and-forget: 73.8% of artifacts are committed once and never modified. Re-estimating an existing agent-adoption panel within each stratum, agents accelerate development regardless of maturity (28-38% more commits), but quality diverges: among agent-first repositories, where the contrast is identified, those without committed AI configuration show roughly twice the increase in cognitive complexity (+53% versus +27%) and 1.7x the increase in static-analysis warnings. Because maturity is observational, correlated engineering discipline or model capability may explain part of the gap; we present these findings as hypothesis-generating and release RAMP as a reusable instrument.
2608.25241.paper_summary_zh: 編碼代理提高了開發速度，但也增加了技術負債。先前的研究報告僅顯示了採用者之間的平均效果，隱藏了團隊之間的巨大差異。我們介紹了 RAMP（倉庫 AI 成熟度檔案），這是一個基於版本控制的工件的四級累積成熟度模型，團隊承諾配置 AI 工具。RAMP 從行為規則和編碼標準開始，經過命名代理定義，最後到多代理協同，觀察到的實踐集中在前三個層級。在 441 個倉庫中，這些層級表現為一個累積的量表，而獨立的人類註釋在 97% 的持出樣本中再現了 RAMP 的倉庫級標籤。採用是累積的、僅向前的，並且是設置後即忘：73.8% 的工件僅被提交一次，從未修改。在每個層級內重新評估現有的代理採用面板，無論成熟度如何，代理都能加速開發（多 28-38% 的提交），但質量卻有所不同：在以代理為主的倉庫中，當對比被識別時，那些沒有提交 AI 配置的倉庫顯示出大約兩倍的認知複雜度增加（+53% 對比 +27%）以及 1.7 倍的靜態分析警告增加。由於成熟度是觀察性的，相關的工程紀律或模型能力可能解釋了部分差距；我們將這些發現作為生成假設的基礎，並將 RAMP 發布為一個可重用的工具。
